title: Let It Be
hook: The *four chords* behind half of pop music
cover_text: The *four chords* behind half of pop

chords.name: C
chords.text: Home base: *C major*. Four chords, endless songs.

chords.name: G
chords.text: The V. Its *B* is the leading tone, aching to go home.

chords.name: Am
chords.text: Instead of home: *A minor*, the sad twin of C.

chords.name: F
chords.text: The IV. *F* is the soft landing.

chords.name: C
chords.text: I–V–vi–IV. You've heard this *a thousand times*.
